coaching.headline: A soft start, then we won every fight that counted and walked Orb Prime straight into their Core.
coaching.team: We started sloppy. Two of our outer towers fell before we took one, and they got the first Fangtooth and the Mini Prime while all five of us were alive. After that we stopped giving shit away: we never lost a fight, turned all five we won into objectives or structures, and took nine structures to their three. Skylar, Willy Guggenheim and Bayle did the killing.

focus.title: Show up for the early majors
focus.action: Before the first Fangtooth and the Mini Prime spawn, decide out loud: all five contest, or we take a tower somewhere else at the same time. Watching them take it with nobody dead does not happen again.

40.7.call: Scarlett opened on Grux, Skylar dropped Legion and Gideon, Steel finished Kwang, and the team lost nobody. Orb Prime followed, then the base fell. That is how a game gets closed: win the fight, take the prize, then walk straight to the Core.

32.4.call: Skylar died first, to Legion, and the team still turned the fight 4-1 while the enemy outer and inner towers fell. One allied outer tower dropped in the same window, so the trade still came out ahead on structures.

29.9.call: Willy Guggenheim's double kill on Legion and Adele started it, Bayle finished Grux, and their outer tower fell in the same window. Skylar was the only loss, to Gideon. Kill the backline, take the tower, reset: repeat that every time.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran a proper fucking support game: zero deaths, the most wards placed and cleared on our team, a hand in more than half our kills, and more damage mitigated than any of us.

Gideon did the most damage on their side and landed more kills than any of them. Steel's stuns go on Gideon before Black Hole: Truesilver Bracelet makes Gideon immune to crowd control while its shield holds after the ultimate.
a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc: Skylar ran the hardest carry game in the lobby: our highest hero damage, the most kills in the game, and Adele dead four times. Killing their only healer that often is exactly the right priority. Keep that shit.
Grux and Kwang both carry stuns. Hold Liberator's cleanse for one of those so Skylar keeps shooting instead of eating the follow-up.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster ate the second most damage on the team and died once, early, to Grux. Soaking that much damage for a single death is what a frontline offlane is supposed to look like.

Scarlett's late kills on Legion and Grux came in the fights around Primal Fangtooth and Orb Prime. Same standard next game: when a late major is up, Swan Song goes on their nearest damage dealer and the team follows.
e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3: First blood, three kills on Kwang, the most objective damage on the team and only two deaths. Bayle soaked more damage than anyone in the game and kept swinging like a drunk at closing time.
The early Fangtooth and the Mini Prime still went to them for free. Bayle runs the early objective clock: start the clear toward the pit before each spawn so the team has a jungler to group on.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim farmed like a bastard, finished with the most gold in the game, and actually spent it on people: seven kills for two deaths.
Both deaths went to Gideon. Before trading, park Void Drone on Gideon to drain that big mana pool, then Neural Disruptor hits harder for the mana Gideon is missing.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Duo was Steel and Skylar against carry Legion and support Adele. Adele roots with Imperial Lash and Queen's Garden, mesmerizes with Royal Flourish and was the enemy's only listed healer; Legion slows with Saturation Charge and knocks back with Rally Point. Across the match Gideon was the enemy's top damage dealer with magical burst, while Grux's pull and stuns and Kwang's knockup were the lockdown threats.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies, Tainted Guard reduces healing and bleeds anyone who basic-attacks Steel, and Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage, which pays off with Steel's stuns. Gaia Greaves adds physical armor and Flux Matrix adds magical armor while making nearby enemies take more magical damage with reduced tenacity. Basic attackers like Legion, Grux and Adele and Gideon's magic gave both armor types a target.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Krix adds maximum health. Voracity restores a little health and gold on unit kills, which Leafsong's reduced minion gold discourages a support from taking, while Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns and suits a player with this many assists. Festering Wounds is a draft alternative to Voracity: Steel's stuns would cut healing on Adele and Grux, trading the small kill sustain for anti-heal, though the team already carried four anti-heal items.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to Steel's heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor. Every armor item in this build feeds Heavy Metal, so the augment and the inventory pull the same way. Colossal Crash is the alternative when a longer, wider Shield Slam matters more, trading the knockup for a knockback.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush gives nearby allies movement speed, slow immunity and the ability to pass through heroes, and the crest raises the ward cap. Legion's mines, Grux's Stampede, Gideon's comet, Kwang's ultimate and Adele's Thornbush all slow, so the active had clear uses for engage or escape. Activations are not recorded; the extra ward capacity sits alongside the highest ward count on our team.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: The winning core runs Raiment of Renewal and Tainted Charm. Tainted Charm reduces healing and slows enemies simply by standing near them, which would cover Adele's and Grux's healing without needing to be hit, but it gives up Tainted Guard's armor and some Heavy Metal damage. With zero deaths and four anti-heal items on the team, the current build is a sound keep; Tainted Charm is the swap if enemy healing starts winning fights.

a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc.matchup: Duo was Skylar and Steel against Legion and Adele, and the only early duo deaths were Adele's, both to Skylar. Adele's Queen's Garden pulls flying enemies to the ground, a direct answer to Air Assault, and Adele also roots and mesmerizes. Later threats were Gideon's magical burst and tether root, plus the stuns from Grux and Kwang.
a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc.build: Hypercharge applies on-hit effects at reduced effectiveness and ignores part of bonus physical armor, so Sky Splitter's current-health damage, Tainted Rounds' anti-heal and Viper's armor shred all ride on Skylar's shots. Tainted Rounds cut Adele's and Grux's healing, and Viper helps against Kwang's Stonewall and the armor on Adele's support items. Vanquisher executes heroes at very low health, and Dust Devil adds attack and movement speed while hitting heroes.
a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero Skylar basic-attacked, adding damage against that target and reducing that target's damage to Skylar. Savage Strikes adds stacking physical on-hit damage that heals, and Rallying Roar adds ultimate haste and gives nearby allies movement speed after Atomiser. Ferocity is the alternative to Rallying Roar for long fights, trading the team speed burst for ramping attack speed.
a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc.augment: Assault MK-II lengthens Air Assault's hover and fires an extra missile with each attack while hovering, so it rewards fights where Skylar stays airborne and shooting. Adele's ultimate pulling flying enemies down is the main counter on their side. Plasma Barrage is the alternative if grenade damage against low-health targets matters more than hover time.
a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc.crest: Liberator cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield on a long cooldown. Grux's and Kwang's stuns, Adele's roots and Gideon's delayed tether root all give the cleanse a clear target. Its use is not recorded, so the match cannot show which of those it answered.
a2319134-808e-4456-853f-cf3a14be22fc.improvement: The winning core adds Imperator, which makes critical strikes hit harder. Skylar already has critical chance from four items, so Imperator over Sky Splitter is the swap when the targets are squishy, trading current-health damage, lifesteal and attack speed for bigger crits. Against Kwang's and Grux's health and armor, Sky Splitter is a sound keep.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Kwang was the offlane opponent: Judgement of the Heavens tethers, Surge of the Heavens knocks up and stuns when recalling the blade, Fury of the Heavens slows, and this Kwang built magical with Tainted Scepter's anti-heal. Across the match Legion and Grux brought the physical damage and Gideon the magical burst.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Tainted Blade reduces healing on physical damage and makes Blighted targets take more damage when hit by an ability. Mutilator adds max-health damage on basic attacks and ability hits plus omnivamp. Terminus turns excess lifesteal into a shield, Solaris empowers the next basic attack after a cast and heals, Mistmeadow Buckler answers magical damage, and Rebirth resurrects after a short delay. It is a sustain build that needs to keep hitting heroes to stay alive.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Marrow heals for part of the hero damage dealt, more at low health. Blood Bank adds lifesteal from stored hero damage, and Roses pays bonus gold per takedown and strengthens Marrow after hero kills. That stacks with the lifesteal items, but Kwang's Tainted Scepter and Legion's Tainted Trident cut that healing when they land. Jealousy is a draft alternative to Roses, trading takedown gold for more damage at low health.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Volcaic Slam makes Empowered Cindara leave a rupture that erupts shortly after, damaging and slowing enemies. Empowered Cindara comes from landing Ashen Vow's outer edge on heroes, so the slow only appears when that edge connects. Scarlet Dawn is the alternative for more frequent First Intent dashes and shields, trading the slow zone for mobility.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Liberator cleanses all debuffs and adds a short shield. For a frontline facing Kwang's knockup and Grux's pull and stuns it has a clear purpose, while Swan Song's Unstoppable backflip covers part of the same need during the ultimate. Activations are not recorded.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: Apart from Mistmeadow Buckler's magical armor, every completed item is damage or sustain, and nothing adds physical armor against Legion and Grux. Scarlett died once, so this game never punished it. If physical damage starts winning the frontline trade, a physical armor item in Terminus's slot is the swap, trading lifesteal shielding for flat protection.

e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3.matchup: Grux was the enemy jungler: Smash 'n Grab pulls and stuns, Stampede drags heroes and slows, Warlord's Challenge stuns, and Double Pain heals on every hero hit. Bayle's main target was Kwang, killed three times including first blood, while the enemy's two early majors were taken with all five of us alive.
e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3.build: Malady adds damage against low-health heroes and resets on takedowns. Tainted Trident cuts healing on physical damage, a direct answer to Grux's and Adele's healing. Spear Of Desolation adds ultimate haste and damage after casting Kingslayer, The Perforator ignores part of physical armor against Kwang's Stonewall, and Citadel adds physical armor per nearby enemy hero while lowering theirs. Rebirth resurrects after a short delay.
e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero Bayle basic-attacked for extra damage against that target and less damage from that target. Savage Strikes adds healing physical on-hit, and Ferocity ramps attack speed the longer hero combat lasts. With Swift Strikes and Berserk's attack speed, all of it rewards Bayle staying on one target. Golden Mane is the defensive alternative to Ferocity if burst ends the brawl early.
e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3.augment: Swift Strikes gives the next attack after a cast a burst of attack speed and starts Bayle on the third swing of the basic chain at reduced damage, which suits weaving abilities between attacks. Frenzied Fighter is the alternative, keeping Berserk active indefinitely below its health threshold, trading that rhythm for a stronger low-health brawl.
e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3.crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver deals area damage and heals on hero hits. That matches Bayle's brawling and sits alongside the most healing on our team, though the crest's share of that healing is not recorded.
e6883bce-af43-4199-9d79-d7125804b8e3.improvement: Bayle went off the winning core into an anti-heal, armor-penetration and survival build that fits this lobby, with the most objective damage on the team and two deaths. That is a sound keep. If Grux's pull and stuns start ending fights before Berserk matters, a tenacity item in Rebirth's slot is the comparison, trading the second life for shorter crowd control.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Gideon was the mid opponent and their top damage dealer: a slowing comet, a passive tether that roots after a delay, and Black Hole pulling enemies in. Gideon built Azure Core's low-health shield and Truesilver Bracelet, which gives a shield and crowd-control immunity while it holds after casting the ultimate. The build also stacks maximum mana, which feeds Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion adds area damage on ability hits, and Noxia rewards hitting a marked hero with a second, separate ability. Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power, Wraith Leggings adds damage against low-health heroes, and Caustica ignores part of magical armor, useful against Grux's Absolution and Adele's Xenia. Void Conduit is a support item: magical armor against Gideon plus omnivamp and mana regeneration while near an ally.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion turns spell casts into mana regeneration and gold from hero damage; Philosopher generates gold over time and Runic Focus adds magical power while mana is high. The economy setup sits alongside the most gold in the game, and Void Conduit's mana regeneration supports Runic Focus. Perfection is the alternative to Runic Focus, giving ability haste at high health instead of mana-scaled power.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Combat Veteran adds a little movement speed and passive experience over time, an economy pick that matches the Aion setup. Devastating Bombs is the alternative when isolated targets are common, and Pulsefire Rounds adds damage to basic attacks; both give up the passive experience.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer's Anima gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed. Against Gideon's burst it is the defensive button; when it was used is not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: The build carries the full winning core plus three more slots. Void Conduit already answers Gideon's magic; if Gideon keeps finding kills, another magical armor item over Caustica is the comparison, trading penetration against Grux and Adele for survival. Otherwise keep Caustica.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down
